P46=5 routes the two previous-employer plan slots through P62ACKPT to P64/P65. P64=3 means left to accumulate and is the counted disposition. P64=2 is an excluded IRA rollover.

entries.finding: P48 and P64 label disposition 2 as rolled over into an IRA and 3 as left to accumulate. Preserve U2 exclusion of disposition 2; this is a registered ownership convention, not a finding from observed account values.

Use combined-plan P49 at most once; never add combined-plan P65 alongside it. Amounts outside the adjudicated current/previous route remain explicit off-route dispositions. The inherited duplicate guard is preserved even where the later instrument no longer re-asks combined accounts.

P20, P49 and P65 ask balances now and offer follow-up brackets for nonresponse. Exact codebook domains are pinned per variable: current balances NUM(9.0); previous balances NUM(8.0). U2 keeps top codes as recorded, counts DK/refusal as zero with dispositions, and does not use brackets.

P45 asks about previous-employer pensions aside from IRA/Keogh plans, expected future benefits, and (under the displayed retirement-income condition) regular payments not yet begun. P69 repeats the plan loop at most twice; no third account balance is collected by that loop.

The pension loop covers the family-file head/reference-person slot and designated spouse/partner slot. Other family members are not separate pension-loop respondents. P70CKPT supplies the explicit spouse-loop family-list relationship gate. Individual-record role assignment remains the separate U2 role registry task.

P42 asks about additional tax-deferred plans on the current job; the subsequent P43/P44 questions ask employer contributions and then lead to P45. The U1/U2 balance scope does not invent a second current-job account balance.

entries.finding: P16 identifies formula=1, account=5, both=7, DK=8 and refused=9; P20 is the present account balance for account and combined plans. Use P16, not the later P22 checkpoint, to route P20.
Both previous-employer slots ask P48/P49 only for P46=7 (both). P48=2 is an IRA rollover; P48=3 is left to accumulate. The U2 inherited convention takes only disposition 3.
P46=5 routes the two previous-employer plan slots through P62ACKPT to P64/P65. P64=3 means left to accumulate and is the counted disposition. P64=2 is an excluded IRA rollover.
Exact P62ACKPT wording is retained below; its routing changes across waves and must not be inferred from U1 code constants.
entries.checkpoint_quote:

       AND P62AMT= DK/RF)

entries.finding: The 2015 P62ACKPT heading requires P46=1 AND P52=1 AND P62AMT=DK/RF, but its displayed branch label says only P62AMT=DK/RF. P64/P65 codebook Inap. descriptions exclude formula and combined types.
entries.required_amendment: Replace generic inherited previous_routes with a wave-specific 2015 P62ACKPT predicate after source adjudication.
entries.question: Does the 2015 instrument route only formula plans expecting benefits with P62AMT DK/RF, or any P62AMT DK/RF (including unknown or combined plans)? Obtain a PSID documentary clarification of heading versus branch label and the codebook conflict; preregister the exact accepted plan types and expectation gate before executing. No observed category may resolve this. Independent adjudication: A (genuinely ambiguous); needs u2-draft-4 amendment 5, pending Max's ruling (EV/phase2-20260927/out/u2-adjudicate.md line 123).
entries.refusal: Do not execute this pension route until independent documentary adjudication and any stated preregistration amendment are complete.

entries.finding: P48 and P64 label disposition 2 as rolled over into an IRA and 3 as left to accumulate. Preserve U2 exclusion of disposition 2; this is a registered ownership convention, not a finding from observed account values.

Use combined-plan P49 at most once; never add combined-plan P65 alongside it. Amounts outside the adjudicated current/previous route remain explicit off-route dispositions. The inherited duplicate guard is preserved even where the later instrument no longer re-asks combined accounts.

P20, P49 and P65 ask balances now and offer follow-up brackets for nonresponse. Exact codebook domains are pinned per variable: current balances NUM(9.0); previous balances NUM(8.0). U2 keeps top codes as recorded, counts DK/refusal as zero with dispositions, and does not use brackets.

P45 asks about previous-employer pensions aside from IRA/Keogh plans, expected future benefits, and (under the displayed retirement-income condition) regular payments not yet begun. P69 repeats the plan loop at most twice; no third account balance is collected by that loop.

The pension loop covers the family-file head/reference-person slot and designated spouse/partner slot. Other family members are not separate pension-loop respondents. P70CKPT supplies the explicit spouse-loop family-list relationship gate. Individual-record role assignment remains the separate U2 role registry task.
entries.refusal: Refused by the independent adjudication (EV/phase2-20260927/out/u2-adjudicate.md line 124; disposition F, amendment 5): q2015 p. 166 P70CKPT reads 'WHETHER WIFE/“WIFE” IN FU (CYFUHU=1, 4 & CYAQRTH=202, 222)' and supplies no male code-20 pension-slot bridge. U7 remains unavailable as specified; no assumption of absence or zero balance is permitted.
entries.part_b_finding: See roles:2015.relationship.20. Documented 2015 male legal spouses are Head, code 90 or code 98 and are not pension-loop spouse respondents; the residual male code-20 question is open (docs/design/u2_m1b_psid_research.md).
entries.open_question: If any 2015 Relation to Head code-20 person is male (family-listing CYAQRTH 201), which family-file variables hold his employer-pension items, given that P70CKPT admits only CYAQRTH 202 and 222 to the 2015 spouse pension loop? (Question for PSID staff, docs/design/u2_m1b_psid_research.md section 1; not sent. It is answered from documentation only, never from observed records.)

entries.finding: P16 identifies formula=1, account=5, both=7, DK=8 and refused=9; P20 is the present account balance for account and combined plans. Use P16, not the later P22 checkpoint, to route P20.
Both previous-employer slots ask P48/P49 only for P46=7 (both). P48=2 is an IRA rollover; P48=3 is left to accumulate. The U2 inherited convention takes only disposition 3.
P46=5 routes the two previous-employer plan slots through P62ACKPT to P64/P65. P64=3 means left to accumulate and is the counted disposition. P64=2 is an excluded IRA rollover.
Exact P62ACKPT wording is retained below; its routing changes across waves and must not be inferred from U1 code constants.
entries.checkpoint_quote:
P62ACKPT. CAI Checkpoint: Whether Pension Is DB Only or DC Only


              1. DB Only (P46=1)       3. DC Only (P46=5)      5. All Others (P46=7 or DK/RF)
                   GO TO P69                     ↓                         GO TO P69

Defined Contribution (P46=DC Only)

entries.finding: P62ACKPT sends formula P46=1 and all others (combined, DK, refused/NA) to P69; only P46=5 reaches P63–P65. This is an explicit documentary change from U1.
The draft parameter contract lists account/formula/dk previous account routes for U2, while this wave questionnaire permits only account P46=5.
entries.refusal: The documentary route is resolved, but the ratified section 15 contract still lists the generic account/formula/dk previous route. Application stays refused, and dependent P64/P65 entries stay blocked, until Max rules on u2-draft-4 amendment 5 (independent adjudication D; EV/phase2-20260927/out/u2-adjudicate.md line 125).
entries.resolution: Independent adjudication D (amendment 5): q2017 p. 152 P62ACKPT gives '1. DB Only (P46=1)', '3. DC Only (P46=5)', '5. All Others (P46=7 or DK/RF)'; DB-only and all others go to P69. Only P46=5 (DC only) reaches P63-P65; formula, combined, DK, refused and NA plans are off-route for P64/P65. Combined-plan P48/P49 is counted once, disposition 3 is retained and IRA-rollover disposition 2 is excluded.

entries.finding: P48 and P64 label disposition 2 as rolled over into an IRA and 3 as left to accumulate. Preserve U2 exclusion of disposition 2; this is a registered ownership convention, not a finding from observed account values.

Use combined-plan P49 at most once; never add combined-plan P65 alongside it. Amounts outside the adjudicated current/previous route remain explicit off-route dispositions. The inherited duplicate guard is preserved even where the later instrument no longer re-asks combined accounts.

P20, P49 and P65 ask balances now and offer follow-up brackets for nonresponse. Exact codebook domains are pinned per variable: current balances NUM(9.0); previous balances NUM(8.0). U2 keeps top codes as recorded, counts DK/refusal as zero with dispositions, and does not use brackets.

P45 asks about previous-employer pensions aside from IRA/Keogh plans, expected future benefits, and (under the displayed retirement-income condition) regular payments not yet begun. P69 repeats the plan loop at most twice; no third account balance is collected by that loop.

The pension loop covers the family-file head/reference-person slot and designated spouse/partner slot. Other family members are not separate pension-loop respondents. P70CKPT supplies the explicit spouse-loop family-list relationship gate. Individual-record role assignment remains the separate U2 role registry task.

P42 asks about additional tax-deferred plans on the current job; the subsequent P43/P44 questions ask employer contributions and then lead to P45. The U1/U2 balance scope does not invent a second current-job account balance.

entries.finding: P16 identifies formula=1, account=5, both=7, DK=8 and refused=9; P20 is the present account balance for account and combined plans. Use P16, not the later P22 checkpoint, to route P20.
Both previous-employer slots ask P48/P49 only for P46=7 (both). P48=2 is an IRA rollover; P48=3 is left to accumulate. The U2 inherited convention takes only disposition 3.
P46=5 routes the two previous-employer plan slots through P62ACKPT to P64/P65. P64=3 means left to accumulate and is the counted disposition. P64=2 is an excluded IRA rollover.
Exact P62ACKPT wording is retained below; its routing changes across waves and must not be inferred from U1 code constants.
entries.checkpoint_quote:
P62ACKPT. CAI Checkpoint: Whether Pension Is DB Only or DC Only


              1. DB Only (P46=1)    3. DC Only (P46=5)       5. All Others (P46=7 or DK/RF)
                   GO TO P69                     ↓                      GO TO P69

Plan with Former Employer - Defined Contribution (P46=DC Only)

entries.finding: P62ACKPT sends formula P46=1 and all others (combined, DK, refused/NA) to P69; only P46=5 reaches P63–P65. This is an explicit documentary change from U1.
The draft parameter contract lists account/formula/dk previous account routes for U2, while this wave questionnaire permits only account P46=5.
entries.refusal: The documentary route is resolved, but the ratified section 15 contract still lists the generic account/formula/dk previous route. Application stays refused, and dependent P64/P65 entries stay blocked, until Max rules on u2-draft-4 amendment 5 (independent adjudication D; EV/phase2-20260927/out/u2-adjudicate.md line 126).
entries.resolution: Independent adjudication D (amendment 5): q2019 p. 163 P62ACKPT gives the same three P62ACKPT branches, followed by 'Plan with Former Employer - Defined Contribution (P46=DC Only)'. Only P46=5 (DC only) reaches P63-P65; formula, combined, DK, refused and NA plans are off-route for P64/P65. Combined-plan P48/P49 is counted once, disposition 3 is retained and IRA-rollover disposition 2 is excluded.

entries.finding: P48 and P64 label disposition 2 as rolled over into an IRA and 3 as left to accumulate. Preserve U2 exclusion of disposition 2; this is a registered ownership convention, not a finding from observed account values.

Use combined-plan P49 at most once; never add combined-plan P65 alongside it. Amounts outside the adjudicated current/previous route remain explicit off-route dispositions. The inherited duplicate guard is preserved even where the later instrument no longer re-asks combined accounts.

P20, P49 and P65 ask balances now and offer follow-up brackets for nonresponse. Exact codebook domains are pinned per variable: current balances NUM(9.0); previous balances NUM(8.0). U2 keeps top codes as recorded, counts DK/refusal as zero with dispositions, and does not use brackets.

P45 asks about previous-employer pensions aside from IRA/Keogh plans, expected future benefits, and (under the displayed retirement-income condition) regular payments not yet begun. P69 repeats the plan loop at most twice; no third account balance is collected by that loop.

The pension loop covers the family-file head/reference-person slot and designated spouse/partner slot. Other family members are not separate pension-loop respondents. P70CKPT supplies the explicit spouse-loop family-list relationship gate. Individual-record role assignment remains the separate U2 role registry task.

P42 asks about additional tax-deferred plans on the current job; the subsequent P43/P44 questions ask employer contributions and then lead to P45. The U1/U2 balance scope does not invent a second current-job account balance.

entries.finding: P16 identifies formula=1, account=5, both=7, DK=8 and refused=9; P20 is the present account balance for account and combined plans. Use P16, not the later P22 checkpoint, to route P20.
Both previous-employer slots ask P48/P49 only for P46=7 (both). P48=2 is an IRA rollover; P48=3 is left to accumulate. The U2 inherited convention takes only disposition 3.
P46=5 routes the two previous-employer plan slots through P62ACKPT to P64/P65. P64=3 means left to accumulate and is the counted disposition. P64=2 is an excluded IRA rollover.
Exact P62ACKPT wording is retained below; its routing changes across waves and must not be inferred from U1 code constants.
entries.checkpoint_quote:
P62ACKPT. CAI Checkpoint: Whether Pension Is DB Only or DC Only


             1. DB Only (P46=1)    3. DC Only (P46=5)     5. All Others (P46=7, DK, RF, NA)
                 GO TO P69                 ↓                          GO TO P69



Plan with Former Employer - Defined Contribution (P46=DC Only)

entries.finding: P62ACKPT sends formula P46=1 and all others (combined, DK, refused/NA) to P69; only P46=5 reaches P63–P65. This is an explicit documentary change from U1.
The draft parameter contract lists account/formula/dk previous account routes for U2, while this wave questionnaire permits only account P46=5.
entries.refusal: The documentary route is resolved, but the ratified section 15 contract still lists the generic account/formula/dk previous route. Application stays refused, and dependent P64/P65 entries stay blocked, until Max rules on u2-draft-4 amendment 5 (independent adjudication D; EV/phase2-20260927/out/u2-adjudicate.md line 127).
entries.resolution: Independent adjudication D (amendment 5): q2021 p. 304 P62ACKPT gives '3. DC Only (P46=5)' versus '5. All Others (P46=7, DK, RF, NA)'; all others go to P69. Only P46=5 (DC only) reaches P63-P65; formula, combined, DK, refused and NA plans are off-route for P64/P65. Combined-plan P48/P49 is counted once, disposition 3 is retained and IRA-rollover disposition 2 is excluded.

entries.finding: P48 and P64 label disposition 2 as rolled over into an IRA and 3 as left to accumulate. Preserve U2 exclusion of disposition 2; this is a registered ownership convention, not a finding from observed account values.

Use combined-plan P49 at most once; never add combined-plan P65 alongside it. Amounts outside the adjudicated current/previous route remain explicit off-route dispositions. The inherited duplicate guard is preserved even where the later instrument no longer re-asks combined accounts.

P20, P49 and P65 ask balances now and offer follow-up brackets for nonresponse. Exact codebook domains are pinned per variable: current balances NUM(9.0); previous balances NUM(8.0). U2 keeps top codes as recorded, counts DK/refusal as zero with dispositions, and does not use brackets.

P45 asks about previous-employer pensions aside from IRA/Keogh plans, expected future benefits, and (under the displayed retirement-income condition) regular payments not yet begun. P69 repeats the plan loop at most twice; no third account balance is collected by that loop.

The pension loop covers the family-file head/reference-person slot and designated spouse/partner slot. Other family members are not separate pension-loop respondents. P70CKPT supplies the explicit spouse-loop family-list relationship gate. Individual-record role assignment remains the separate U2 role registry task.

P42 asks about additional tax-deferred plans on the current job; the subsequent P43/P44 questions ask employer contributions and then lead to P45. The U1/U2 balance scope does not invent a second current-job account balance.

entries.finding: P46 codebook explicitly says DK and NA/refused were corrected for this variable because their paths differ. Preserve codes 8 and 9 distinctly; never infer a later wave code set from U1 _NEW_CODES_WAVES.

entries.finding: P16 identifies formula=1, account=5, both=7, DK=8 and refused=9; P20 is the present account balance for account and combined plans. Use P16, not the later P22 checkpoint, to route P20.
Both previous-employer slots ask P48/P49 only for P46=7 (both). P48=2 is an IRA rollover; P48=3 is left to accumulate. The U2 inherited convention takes only disposition 3.
P46=5 routes the two previous-employer plan slots through P62ACKPT to P64/P65. P64=3 means left to accumulate and is the counted disposition. P64=2 is an excluded IRA rollover.
Exact P62ACKPT wording is retained below; its routing changes across waves and must not be inferred from U1 code constants.
entries.checkpoint_quote:
P62ACKPT. CAI Checkpoint: Whether Pension Is DB Only or DC Only


             1. DB Only (P46=1)    3. DC Only (P46=5)     5. All Others (P46=7, DK, RF, NA)
                 GO TO P69                                           GO TO P69



Plan with Former Employer - Defined Contribution (P46=DC Only)

entries.finding: P62ACKPT sends formula P46=1 and all others (combined, DK, refused/NA) to P69; only P46=5 reaches P63–P65. This is an explicit documentary change from U1.
The draft parameter contract lists account/formula/dk previous account routes for U2, while this wave questionnaire permits only account P46=5.
entries.refusal: The documentary route is resolved, but the ratified section 15 contract still lists the generic account/formula/dk previous route. Application stays refused, and dependent P64/P65 entries stay blocked, until Max rules on u2-draft-4 amendment 5 (independent adjudication D; EV/phase2-20260927/out/u2-adjudicate.md line 128).
entries.resolution: Independent adjudication D (amendment 5): q2023 p. 302 P62ACKPT gives '3. DC Only (P46=5)' versus '5. All Others (P46=7, DK, RF, NA)'; all others go to P69. Only P46=5 (DC only) reaches P63-P65; formula, combined, DK, refused and NA plans are off-route for P64/P65. Combined-plan P48/P49 is counted once, disposition 3 is retained and IRA-rollover disposition 2 is excluded.

entries.finding: P48 and P64 label disposition 2 as rolled over into an IRA and 3 as left to accumulate. Preserve U2 exclusion of disposition 2; this is a registered ownership convention, not a finding from observed account values.

Use combined-plan P49 at most once; never add combined-plan P65 alongside it. Amounts outside the adjudicated current/previous route remain explicit off-route dispositions. The inherited duplicate guard is preserved even where the later instrument no longer re-asks combined accounts.

P20, P49 and P65 ask balances now and offer follow-up brackets for nonresponse. Exact codebook domains are pinned per variable: current balances NUM(9.0); previous balances NUM(8.0). U2 keeps top codes as recorded, counts DK/refusal as zero with dispositions, and does not use brackets.

P45 asks about previous-employer pensions aside from IRA/Keogh plans, expected future benefits, and (under the displayed retirement-income condition) regular payments not yet begun. P69 repeats the plan loop at most twice; no third account balance is collected by that loop.

The pension loop covers the family-file head/reference-person slot and designated spouse/partner slot. Other family members are not separate pension-loop respondents. P70CKPT supplies the explicit spouse-loop family-list relationship gate. Individual-record role assignment remains the separate U2 role registry task.

P42 asks about additional tax-deferred plans on the current job; the subsequent P43/P44 questions ask employer contributions and then lead to P45. The U1/U2 balance scope does not invent a second current-job account balance.
